text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. One key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of following fixed rules. A more advanced form is deep learning, which uses complex neural networks inspired by the human brain. AI is already everywhere in daily life. It powers voice assistants, recommends movies on streaming services, filters spam emails, and even helps doctors analyze medical scans. As AI improves, it will keep changing how we live and work.
